title: Hunt Fish Kauai
specs: Fishing from the leeward side of Kauai for calmer seas
Opportunity to catch marlin, yellowfin tuna, mahi mahi, wahoo, and other pelagic species
One day saltwater fishing license required
Minimum age for private charters is 5 years
Not recommended for pregnant women or anyone with health, heart, or back problems
Private trips only, no shared charters; 1-6 passengers per boat
includes: Water, juice, soda provided on the boat
Licensed Coast Guard captain and experienced crew
Fully enclosed restrooms with toilets, sink, and mirrors on both boats

blurb: Guests join private fishing charters on a 36-foot Hatteras vessel departing from Port Allen Small Boat Harbor. They fish for pelagic species like marlin, yellowfin tuna, mahi mahi, and wahoo using various methods including trolling, jigging, and bottom fishing. Trips are customized for all skill levels and last 4, 6, or 8 hours.
extraNote: Cancellations made 10 or more days before the scheduled charter are eligible for a 100% refund · Cancellations made 9 to 3 days before the charter are eligible for a 50% refund · Cancellations made within 72 hours of the charter are non-refundable · Captain decides to cancel due to weather; no charge if canceled for weather and rescheduling attempted · Cancellations within 10 days of the charter are a 50% charge due to holding a boat for reservation · 72-hour cancellation or no-show is non-refundable · Prices do not include taxes, harbor fees, or gratuities for crew members · Port Allen Small Boat Harbor, first two slips on the first dock
